```python
from copy import deepcopy


def paginate_records(title, rows, page_size):
    if not isinstance(title, str):
        raise TypeError("title must be a string")
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise TypeError("rows must be a list")
    if isinstance(page_size, bool) or not isinstance(page_size, int):
        raise TypeError("page_size must be an integer")
    if page_size <= 0:
        raise ValueError("page_size must be positive")

    pages = []
    for start in range(0, len(rows), page_size):
        pages.append({
            "heading": title + " (continued)",
            "rows": deepcopy(rows[start:start + page_size]),
        })
    return pages
```

import unittest

from solution import paginate_records


class PaginateRecordsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_multiple_pages_headings_and_order(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            paginate_records("Report", [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2),
            [
                {"heading": "Report", "rows": [1, 2]},
                {"heading": "Report (continued)", "rows": [3, 4]},
                {"heading": "Report (continued)", "rows": [5]},
            ],
        )

    def test_exact_page_and_single_page(self):
        self.assertEqual(paginate_records("", [1, 2], 2),
                         [{"heading": "", "rows": [1, 2]}])
        self.assertEqual(paginate_records("T", [1], 10),
                         [{"heading": "T", "rows": [1]}])

    def test_empty_rows_returns_fresh_empty_list(self):
        first = paginate_records("T", [], 1)
        second = paginate_records("T", [], 1)
        self.assertEqual(first, [])
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)

    def test_deep_copy_and_no_aliasing(self):
        nested = {"items": [[1]]}
        rows = [nested, [2, {"x": 3}]]
        pages = paginate_records("T", rows, 1)
        pages[0]["rows"][0]["items"][0].append(4)
        pages[1]["rows"][0][1]["x"] = 9
        self.assertEqual(rows, [{"items": [[1]]}, [2, {"x": 3}]])
        nested["items"][0].append(5)
        self.assertEqual(pages[0]["rows"][0], {"items": [[1, 4]]})
        self.assertIsNot(pages[0]["rows"], pages[1]["rows"])

    def test_validation(self):
        for title in (None, 1, b"x"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                paginate_records(title, [], 1)
        for rows in (None, (), {}, "x"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                paginate_records("T", rows, 1)
        for size in (True, False, 1.0, "1", None):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                paginate_records("T", [], size)
        for size in (0, -1):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                paginate_records("T", [], size)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
